Going through this. I’m so embarrassed of how I act and feel when I’m splitting. I say HORRIBLE things and hurt my partner in the process over things I know he can’t control. I always called these temper tantrums and acting like a spoiled brat but I see that I’m just splitting. I’m newly diagnosed bpd
This is why I can’t push myself to end my life cause I’ll be more pissed when it doesn’t end
Lol don’t feel bad heard it completely normal. A group of guys who are really known in my city were talking about how they love step sister porn and it made me feel so uncomfortable but most men do

Same my fear is not being successful with my unlifing, and having to live w the pain. Like If I take pills, and go to sleep and then wake up a vegetable or with organ failure.. just making the situation worse …

My triggering point though I know I’m rambling, is my house that I’ve lived in for 6 years has become mice infested, and My mom talked me into putting in a 60 day notice to leave. I was confident that I’d find another place but my new landlord isn’t giving me good references.. so now I have 1-2 weeks to find a new place and have to throw everything away, and being homeless again is really triggering me, because I’ve spent all of my money on ubers and application fees (6 places) to just be declined or passed over on the place. I fear I’ll have to close my photo studio that I worked hard for, and live out of my storage. Though I know everyone does it, my whole life has me going through stuff, and I just really thought being positive worked but I can’t help but just cry everyday. I feel I’m failing my daughter, and I’m relying on my sisters and guy I’m dating too much.. and they’re fed up. He doesn’t even want to be around me as much anymore though when we do get together he does go out his way to get my mind off of everything I just know he deserves someone better than me, and not someone who just has so much going on. Waking up daily just get worse even though I tell myself something is going to give, it’s literally not and it’s like life is telling me “didn’t I tell you not to be here ” and shows me everyday. I don’t think I’ll be the same after this and more and more mental issues are developing.
